brief:
A United Nations commission of inquiry said Israel continued committing genocide in Gaza after the US-brokered ceasefire that began last October, according to Al-Monitor. The finding appeared in a report released Monday. Israel rejected the assessment, characterizing it as part of a "misinformation campaign."

The inquiry did not specify the timeframe or scope of alleged post-ceasefire acts, nor did it detail which Israeli actions the commission determined constituted genocide under international law.
dek: GENEVA, Oct 26 (Reuters) - Israel continued to commit genocide in Gaza after last October's US-brokered ceasefire in the enclave, a UN commission said in a report published on Monday that Israel dismissed as part of a "misinformation campaign".
title: UN inquiry finds Israel committed genocide in Gaza after ceasefire
